limitations: All results belong only to this exact guarded f831 push V3 run; they are not transferred to the f831 PR trial,2dfc or another run.
Phase counts overlap and are not added into one unique total.

The source aggregate reports6821 cases across105 declared selectors including directories, not independent per-module case verdicts. tests/ui/test_word_citations.py is included explicitly; its individual19-case rows/timings have not been read from the retained v3-tests.xml.
The native clip probe explicitly leaves selected-endpoint loop playback NOT_RUN despite this branch's separate MAIN endpoint provisioning.
Actual physical microphone, acoustic quality, manual NVDA, private model quality, whole MAIN/full-bundle acceptance and release/wheel eligibility are not qualified.
The guarded f831 MAIN is still running full source after failed capture26 and bundle66; this V3 success does not supersede those failures.
